heroic-gogdl
============

OmniLibrary can download heroic-gogdl 1.2.2 on demand from the official
Heroic-Games-Launcher release. heroic-gogdl is not embedded in the Tools for
Steam source tree or installer.

Project: https://github.com/Heroic-Games-Launcher/heroic-gogdl
Release asset:
https://github.com/Heroic-Games-Launcher/heroic-gogdl/releases/download/v1.2.2/gogdl_windows_x86_64.exe
Expected SHA-256:
37e7cf848d35ffff92dfaeb62d7751709e0b8a0deb17dda36a013d73300e61c1
License: GNU General Public License v3.0
License text and corresponding source:
https://github.com/Heroic-Games-Launcher/heroic-gogdl/tree/v1.2.2

Tools for Steam stores heroic-gogdl and its GOG session in the isolated
data\omnilibrary directory. Disconnect GOG Account removes that session and
the isolated browser profile without deleting installed game files.
